goblin.description: A scrappy goblin that stabs anything within reach.
goblin.name: Goblin

powers.description: Flies into a rage, increasing damage and attack speed.
powers.name: Enrage

goblin-archer.description: Hangs back and looses crude arrows at whoever it's angry at.
goblin-archer.name: Goblin Archer

powers.description: A heavy shot with a barbed head.
powers.name: Barbed Arrow

powers.description: An arrow to the leg that slows the target.
powers.name: Crippling Shot

goblin-boss.description: The pack's loudest goblin: tough, slow to kill, and it makes the whole pack nastier.
goblin-boss.name: Goblin Boss

powers.description: A bellow that rallies the whole pack.
powers.name: Rallying Roar

powers.description: A heavy thump that leaves the target dazed.
powers.name: Skull Thump

goblin-shaman.description: A goblin channeling crude but effective battle magic.
goblin-shaman.name: Goblin Shaman

powers.description: Spits a glob of corrosive acid at the target.
powers.name: Acid Splash

goblin-sneak.description: A knife-artist that slips past the front line to stab healers in the back.
goblin-sneak.name: Goblin Sneak

powers.description: A vicious stab to an exposed back.
powers.name: Backstab

powers.description: A dirty blow that leaves the target dazed.
powers.name: Cheap Shot
